proposals.evidence: DEDR 4753 full article (p. 421) gives 4753 Ta. mar̤ai rain, cloud, water, blackness, darkness, coolness; ( -pp-, -tt- ) to be charged with rain, become dark as a cloud, be cool. Ma. mar̤a rain. Ko. may id. To. maw id.; maṣ tïṟ w Bhat mare “rain” matches Lindgren Koraga mare “rain (precipitation)” in form and sense; this cross-source match is a candidate lead, with the full DEDR article defining the family. Both source identities and dialect tags are preserved.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 4715 full article (p. 417) gives Kor. (T.) marje grandson; marji granddaughter; (O.) marmayi son-in-law. Bhat marji “granddaughter” is the same cited Koraga form and sense; its original dialect:Koraga:tappu:Tappu uncertain dialect tag is retained. The article is used as family classification, not an independent second attestation of Bhat.
